name: Rent Assistance
summary: An extra fortnightly amount for people who pay private rent and get an eligible payment.
key: Up to $223.80 a fortnight for a single person with no children, reached once rent is $456.20 a fortnight or more. Rates from 20 September 2026.
numbers: Rent needed for the maximum rate
catches: We have not confirmed the student-specific rules yet, such as which Youth Allowance recipients qualify, so they are not stated here.
Rates are indexed each March and September.

source.label: DSS Social Security Guide: Rent Assistance current rates
